mutants.intent: Skip F_ADD_SEALS so the memfd copy is never write-sealed after fchmod.
mutants.property: ADR-0005 Decision §1.3 / acceptance 'no seal': the copy must be sealed (F_SEAL_WRITE|GROW|SHRINK|SEAL) so it cannot change after digest.

mutants.intent: Digest the on-disk file after copy instead of reading back the sealed memfd.
mutants.property: ADR-0005 Decision §2 / acceptance 'digest from disk instead of the copy': digest must be of the sealed copy, not the path on disk.

mutants.intent: On seal failure, close the memfd and fall back to an on-disk O_RDONLY fd instead of raising.
mutants.property: ADR-0005 Decision §6 / acceptance 'path fallback on failure': open_executable must raise ImplementationUnavailable and never fall back to the path/disk artefact.

mutants.intent: Use caller pass_fds as the whole set (defaulting to the handle) instead of merging the handle into the caller set.
mutants.property: ADR-0005 Decision §3 / acceptance 'pass_fds replaced instead of merged': caller pass_fds must be merged with the sealed-copy fd, not replaced.

mutants.intent: Stop refusing executable= so subprocess can exec a different binary than the sealed copy.
mutants.property: ADR-0005 Decision §3 / acceptance 'executable= passed through'; run docstring: executable= is refused because it can run something other than the copy.

mutants.intent: On EINVAL from memfd_create with MFD_EXEC, raise instead of retrying without MFD_EXEC.
mutants.property: ADR-0005 Decision §1.2 / acceptance 'the MFD_EXEC retry removed': pre-6.3 kernels reject MFD_EXEC with EINVAL and the helper must retry without it.

mutants.intent: Build argv from real_path strings instead of /proc/self/fd sealed paths.
mutants.property: ADR-0005 Decision §3–4 and module docstring: run must exec the sealed copy via /proc/self/fd so nothing is resolved by path after the copy.

mutants.intent: Stop refusing preexec_fn= so the caller can run arbitrary code in the child before exec.
mutants.property: ADR-0005 Decision §3 and run docstring: preexec_fn= is refused because it can run something other than the copy.

mutants.intent: Drop the regular-file check so a FIFO or other non-regular PATH hit is opened and copied.
mutants.property: ADR-0005 Decision §1.2 / open_executable docstring: a source that is not a regular file is refused (O_NONBLOCK open alone is not enough).

mutants.intent: Compute the digest before fchmod/seals so bytes written through the fd after digest and before seal are what run.
mutants.property: ADR-0005 Decision §2: digest is read back over the whole sealed file after sealing, so bytes present when sealed match the digest.
